SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS average_bandwidth_usage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS excess_overall_average
FROM telescopes AS t
WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.observstation
HAVING AVG(t.bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes)
ORDER BY excess_overall_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
